prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: actual production 16-frame water animation sprite sheet for the Spring tribe nest in Spawner. This sheet will be cut into the real animated water layers.
Image 1 is the locked original nest design, palette, painterly detail, proportions, outlines, lighting and camera. Image 2 is an exact 4-column by 4-row aligned template with 16 copies at the required positions. EDIT IMAGE 2 IN PLACE, keep its 2048x1024 canvas and each 512x256 cell, retain the whole nest at identical coordinates and size in every cell.
Animate a calm 4-second loop, row-major chronological order, 16 different consecutive phases at 0.25 second intervals, last frame naturally leading into first. Quiet spring water wells gently in the central pool, the shallow swell becomes an elliptical ripple that expands outward, reaches the front-right spillway, and slides down the spillway as a single soft low wavelet. The pool becomes calm as the next very small swell begins. Keep the center visually a flat horizontal pool: the swell is only a low curved surface, never a bead, egg, droplet, pillar or new object.
Phases: row 1, frames 0-3: calm initial pool, central shallow swell slowly develops, an inner pale curved ripple forms and widens. Row 2 frames 4-7: ripple expands to the outer pool and carries toward the front-right; the left rear curled wave tip unrolls VERY slightly with delayed motion. Row 3 frames 8-11: ripple reaches the spillway, a small flattened water ridge travels DOWN and FORWARD over the existing spillway, its moving highlight grows long then tapers. Row 4 frames 12-15: that ridge flattens and flows away into the same existing water rim, ripple fades by shortening its drawn contour, left curl settles, final surface leads into frame 0 without snapping.
Critical invariants: low wide nest, original fixed outer bottom contour, thick front rim, back rim, scale, perspective, shading, brush texture, and opaque teal palette are EXACTLY the same in all cells. Only redraw the open INNER water surface and the INNER spillway for the phase. Curl tip may change a tiny amount; outer shell does not breathe, bounce, rotate, expand or drift. Ripple LINES change their actual shapes and lengths in the drawing, not simply a rotated or offset copy. Bright bands follow physical ripple slopes; ambient lighting remains fixed with no global brightness or color pulsing. Keep changes readable but restrained (surface swell below 2% of nest height).
Match every cell in Image 2 precisely; each entire nest has generous transparent margins and does not touch adjacent cells. True alpha transparency, no ground/shadow/backdrop, no grid, text, labels, foam, particles, bubbles or splashes. Preserve the exact rendering style and details of Image 1. All 16 cells must be fully painted and distinct consecutive drawings.
